description.value:
Your mastery of water allows you to infuse your own self with the essence of waves.

As an Action, you undergo the transformation and gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

  • You ignore all water-based effects such as the Tsunami spell or a natural vortex.
  • You gain Immunity to cold damage.
  • Water flows from everywhere, including up from the ground and dropping as rain to form a vortex of writhing watery tentacles in a 60 feet radius around you that makes the area 3. You and any number of creatures of your choice in the area unaffected.
  • Any other creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there has to make a Dexterity Saving Throw against your save DC or be Grappled and Restrained. It can make a Strength check as an Action on its turn to no longer be Grappled and Restrained.

Once you have used this ability, you can't use it again until you have finished a Long Rest.
